issues.detail: The Hebrew says Mehetabel was the daughter of Matred, daughter of Me-zahab (בַּת מַטְרֵד בַּת מֵי זָהָב). The Chinese renders '是米薩合的孫女、瑪特列的女兒' (granddaughter of Me-zahab, daughter of Matred), which reverses the genealogy: it makes her the granddaughter of Me-zahab and daughter of Matred, whereas the Hebrew states she is the daughter of Matred and granddaughter of Me-zahab. This swaps the generational order of the two names.
